title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode5 Because I'm Your Senpai

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come back again soon, you two.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We will. Thanks, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That was a good first step.
I'm so glad the four of them got to perform together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It did turn into a bit of an argument at the end there...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm sure everything will be just fine!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Saki said she wouldn't ever give up. Ichika doesn't seem like she's about to give up, either.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've got to work even harder to make sure everyone can find their true feelings again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's still a problem, though. I'm sure Ichika and Saki will be back again, but I'm not sure what to do about Shiho and Honami.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If I can find a way to hold an even better play session, maybe they'll be more willing to admit how they feel. I don't know if that will be enough, though...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Great work, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Where were you? I was hoping you would play with us.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? Did you have any trouble without me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: N-No, not exactly...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I didn't want to take away from your debut as their senpai, so I decided to sit back and watch today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I've noticed that you've really been practicing hard for today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What? Don't tell me you saw that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Heh.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, you're always teasing me like this...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Sorry, you're just so cute when you're flustered. I couldn't help myself. It sure was nice to hear you and the others play.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's often easier to understand a person's heart through their music than what they say.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, it sure is. I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika's music sounded like she was really giving it her all. It felt like she really wanted to spend time with the others like they used to.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Saki's sounded really happy. I got the sense she was simply enjoying the opportunity to spend time with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Shiho's playing was very precise, but it felt like she was purposefully preventing her sound from properly mixing with the others'.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it was a very stubborn sound, wasn't it? I wonder if there's a reason she felt the need to do that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And Honami...sounded like she was afraid of something.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Even so, I got the sense they were beginning to show their true feelings, even if they weren't aware of it themselves.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I got the same feeling. I bet being in a band again will help them remember how they used to feel.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure everyone will come back soon, so I need to start practicing again so I'm ready!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, good luck. I hope I get the chance to play with you guys next time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: When they do arrive, be sure to introduce me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course. I was planning on introducing you as my senpai.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, I'll have to be sure not to do anything unbecoming of a proper senpai, won't I?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Like teasing those your juniors?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? Is someone still a little sore?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No... Just a little embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Miku.
You're just so cute when you're working hard.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hearing that is embarrassing too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Come on, Miku. Let's put in another full day of practice, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm counting on my senpai!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Luka
rows.Line: Heh.
